audio: fetch by manifest URI, mono-mean, resample16k + utterance z-norm (calibrate _preprocess_wave), bfloat16
decode: CTC greedy over model logits truncated to the returned seq_len; consecutive-duplicate collapse; blank drop; skip-special decode (calibrate _ctc_greedy_text)
decode_parity_rule: the evaluator IMPORTS _preprocess_wave and _ctc_greedy_text from pipeline.omniasr_calibrate — the exact functions the mandatory in-run upstream-parity probe validates on every calibration; the evaluator adds NO decode logic of its own
environment_contract: MEDZEN_EXECUTION_MODE=arm2_scoring (strict enum, launcher+trainer parity); MEDZEN_SCORE_* pins injected by the launcher from the reviewed scoring packet
inputs: scoring manifest fetched by EXACT VersionId + sha; identities only + audio locations; the evaluator NEVER sees references
model_loading: stage_model_artifacts (the trainer's own staging step) pulls the base checkpoint to /models BEFORE architecture load; export weights fetched by EXACT S3 VersionId and sha-verified (strict load) — a substituted model refuses
purpose: Frozen decoding contract for the PROTECTED ATTESTED EVALUATOR (Codex final-gap correction item 1): pins the exact decode path, audio preprocessing, model-loading rule and receipts schema BEFORE any candidate hypotheses exist.

receipts_schema.attestation: the workflow's attest mode signs the EXACT receipts bytes with actions/attest-build-provenance (pinned v2.2.3); the scorer verifies the Sigstore bundle cryptographically
receipts_schema.file: {record, job_name, arm, model_sha256, model_artifact{s3_uri,s3_version_id}, training_packet_canonical_sha256, split_sha256, evaluator_image_digest, manifest_sha256, rows:[{audio_checksum_sha256, hyp_normalized}]}
